messages:
Hannah B: opened PR to refactor the Dedicated provisioning doc into smaller examples + add a JSON Schema for scalePolicy. PR: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/1110
Rafael D: looked quick. big ask: include a short concurrency advisory that explains how batching + caching interact with autoscale. customers assume higher batching always lowers cost but it can delay scale decisions.
Maya C: agree. propose a short note: 'Batching increases per-request latency and can mask utilization spikes; use conservative cooldowns when aggressive batching is enabled.'
DevRel Sam: can we also add a tiny rwctl example for Terraform users and a link to the sample terraform module? e.g.: `rwctl provision reservation --name=ml-test --gpus=2 --labels=team:ml` then `terraform apply`. I'll paste module link.
Hannah B: adding a JSON Schema snippet under examples/scale_policy.json and a minimal JS + CLI example. Also planning a small diagram (PNG) to show routing fallback paths. docs-bot: heads-up if images are added we need alt text for accessibility.
docs-bot: link-checker: image "assets/diagrams/dedicated-routing.png" missing alt text and current anchor `#scalePolicy-schema` is broken.
ops-oncall: ops note: include explicit wording on SLO vs SLA. Ops prefers: 'SLA: 99.95% reserved capacity uptime; SLO: internal 99.9% placement latency for allocations under 30s'. Also mention quota enforcement window (15m) and that the routing fallback can try hosted variants for up to 2 minutes.
Rafael D: small API nit: our JS SDK uses `reservation.updateScalePolicy(...)` and the Go SDK uses `UpdateScalePolicy(ctx, opts)`. Add both snippets to be thorough.
Maya C: localization ask: translations team wants short strings for the SLA table and code comment copies to avoid long sentences in i18n. Keep copy modular.
Legal Team: legal: avoid the phrase 'best effort' — suggest: 'Capacity may be preempted for emergency maintenance; scheduled maintenance will provide at least 24 hours' notice.' We'll queue a brief legal approval once PR updated.
Hannah B: action items: 1) add JSON Schema file + examples, 2) add batching + autoscale advisory, 3) include rwctl and Terraform module links, 4) fix image alt text and broken anchor, 5) add multilingual short-form strings and tag localization, 6) update SLA wording and request legal review. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
DevRel Sam: I'll add the terraform module link and a short sample app showing tenant-labels + fallback behavior (DEVREL-341).
ops-oncall: will update internal runbook notes after merge and double-check runtime placement time windows. +1
Rafael D: once PR is green, please squash and ping for a quick smoke review. Also add a one-line changelog entry for the schema addition.
Hannah B: will do. thanks all :sparkles:
